normalization: NFKC and whitespace; vendor/description casefold; exact units, signs and currency markers; Decimal strings without rounding; printed MM/DD/YYYY or English month dates
record_matching: Complete associated records as a multiset; duplicates retain multiplicity
representation_policy: Prefer Markdown line-item tables when present, suppressing duplicated linear text. Reuse headers for Markdown page continuations; concatenate description-only rows. Otherwise consume linear description-before-values rows under displayed header roles.
limits: No OCR or semantic repair. Merged FROM/TO text is ambiguous. Within-word wraps, values followed by description fragments and missing headers may defeat extraction. This is a configured pipeline test on retained templates, not an unseen test set.
denominators: Eligible documents and five fields per document stay fixed, including failures, empty outputs and timeouts as zero recovery. Grader exceptions invalidate aggregates.
change_reason: Typing and CI maintenance only; primary v3 invoice runs retain protocol revision 2 and frozen evaluator bytes. No new primary comparison is implied.
development_policy: Typing maintenance after the primary comparison, with no scoring-rule tuning. The scored primary v3 bundles retain development revision 2 and their frozen evaluator snapshots.
